LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_LivePreviewNote: Live preview - drag the sliders and watch the result. Nothing changes until you press Apply.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_UseRecommendedSetupTip: Resets every slider to its default and hands Pool/Anti-mech back to the automatic system (material stock / mechanoid threat).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_DetailedModeTip: Detailed mode - every slider is shown for hand-tuning.\n\nClick to switch to Simple (presets only).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_SimpleModeTip: Simple mode - presets only, the sliders are hidden.\n\nClick to switch to Detailed and hand-tune every slider.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MechSliderAssignTip: What the squad should be armed against.\n\nSeeded automatically from mechanoid encounters / colony age, until you drag it yourself.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_AmmoVarSliderTip: How eagerly each colonist's ammo mixes types (e.g. FMJ + a magazine of EMP). Only applies with "Override ammo" on.\n\nLeft: exactly one type per weapon. Right: up to four, whenever a type covers a threat nothing packed yet covers. The total round count never grows - variety splits it - and every ration stays at least a full magazine, so small budgets keep fewer types regardless.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_CraftSliderTip: How willing the assignment is to hand out weapons you don't own yet.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MeleeSliderTip: Shifts who counts as a shooter vs a brawler.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_DiversitySliderTip: Left: everyone gets the highest-value weapon. Right: the squad avoids duplicates and fills classic roles first.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_BudgetSliderTip: Only matters for weapons that must be crafted.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_SidearmCoverageSliderTip: Adds a second weapon alongside the main one (opposite type - a ranged main gets a melee backup and vice versa), the same live way Equipment Packs attach. Covers this fraction of the squad, best combat priority first.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_GrenadeCoverageSliderTip: Adds a grenade (satchel charge, stick bomb, ...) alongside the main weapon, listed together with the sidearm above but from its own separate pool - a grenade never bumps a real backup weapon out of its slot. Covers this fraction of the squad, best combat priority first. Picks from grenades you own or can craft.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_PackCoverageSliderTip: Ranks pack TYPES by essentialness and includes progressively more as this rises - basic supply (food/medicine) first, specialized content (medical/drugs/utility) layered on after. Every eligible pawn gets every included pack type (Medical-dominant packs still only go to designated medics) - this is NOT about excluding pawns, only about which pack types exist at all. Shield-bearing packs are NOT covered by this slider - see below.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_ShieldCoverageSliderTip: Hands out any pack containing a shield (checked by its actual contents, not its name) to this fraction of the squad's melee-oriented pawns (or the whole squad if nobody is melee-oriented), best melee fighters first - gradually, like the sidearm/explosives sliders above, not an all-or-nothing tier.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_RedistributeCarriedWeapon: Weapons picked up manually count as redistributable.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MaxSidearmBulkTip: The auto-solver never picks a candidate above this CE Bulk value as a sidearm (a full rifle shouldn't be handed out as someone's "backup" just because it scores well). Manual sidearm picks aren't capped. Shared with the mod settings' Loadout Defaults tab.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_KeepCurrentLoadoutsTip: On: only colonists without a loadout get one; everyone already equipped is left untouched (shown with a lock).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_OverrideAmmoTip: Re-pick each colonist's ammo fresh at assign time (current stock/research + the Anti-mech and ammo-type sliders) instead of using the weapon's default ammo. Roles are never affected - their ammo always comes from the Role itself.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_BackButtonTip: Back to the previous step of the Arm-my-Colony flow. Steps that already applied are not undone.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_UnpinAllTip: Remove all {0} manual pin(s) and hand those colonists back to the solver.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_SkipButtonTip: Skip this step - nothing is assigned here, the Arm-my-Colony flow continues to the next step.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_UnlockEveryoneTip: Unlock everyone. The auto-assign plans all colonists again.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_LockEveryoneTip: Lock everyone. Nobody is re-planned until unlocked.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_NoChangesCurrentSettings: No changes with the current settings.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_PreviewCraftingCostsHeade: Preview - crafting costs by component (adjust in the next screen):
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_ProblemClickToFix: Click to open the Roles tab.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_CannotFightTip: Cannot fight (incapable of violence, or a baby) - protected and never assigned a loadout.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_RangedScoreTip: Ranged score (Shooting x10, adjusted by sight/manipulation/traits).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MeleeScoreTip: Melee score (Melee x10, adjusted by moving/manipulation/traits).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MedicalScoreTip: Medical skill (Medicine x10) - the top share of the squad by this score gets Medical-dominant Equipment Packs.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_CannotFightNoWeaponTip: This colonist cannot fight (incapable of violence, or a baby) and never gets a weapon.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_NoLoadoutCouldBeAssignedT: No loadout could be assigned to this colonist with the current settings.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_ClickToPickLoadoutTip: Click to pick a weapon for {0} manually (pins the choice - sliders won't reshuffle it).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_CurrentlyPinnedAutoSuffix: \n\nCurrently pinned - the menu offers Auto to hand the colonist back to the solver.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_DragToSwapSuffix: \n\nDrag onto another colonist's row to swap their planned loadouts.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_RoleNoPackItemsTip: This Role includes no medicine/food/drug/utility items.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_RoleNoSidearmTip: This Role includes no sidearm, thrown explosive, or shield.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_PackClickOverrideSuffix: \n\nScored automatically alongside the weapon. Click to override which packs this colonist gets - a pending pin, like the weapon cell; nothing applies until you press Apply.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_TickPacksSubtitle: {0} - tick which packs to plan. Nothing applies until you press Apply.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_SidearmClickTickSuffix: \n\nClick to tick which weapon(s) {0} carries as a sidearm - a pending pin, like the weapon cell; nothing applies until you press Apply.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_TickSidearmsSubtitle: {0} - tick which weapon(s) to carry as a sidearm. Nothing applies until you press Apply.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_NoOtherWeaponLoadoutsEmpt: No other weapons available to carry as a sidearm.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_UnsustainableNotResearche: - covered for now, can't be re-made (not researched)
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_UnsustainableNoBenchSuffi: - covered for now, can't be re-made (no bench built)
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_CantSwapCannotFight: Can't swap onto a colonist who can't fight (pacifist or baby).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_BothColonistsNeedConcrete: Both colonists need a planned weapon or role to swap.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_BothColonistsSameLoadout: Both colonists already plan the same loadout.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_SkippedByYouTip: You set this colonist to "skipped", so auto-assign leaves them alone. They CAN fight - this is your decision, not a trait of the pawn. Click the icon on the far left to include them again.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MarkPlannedTip: Will be planned: the auto-assign picks a loadout for this colonist.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MarkKeptTip: Kept as is: the auto-assign leaves this colonist's loadout alone. Still fully editable - click the weapon cell any time to change it directly.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MarkRemovedTip: Loadout will be taken away: on Apply, {0} loses their loadout and stands there with none. The gear itself stays in the colony.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_MarkRemovedNoneTip: Left out: {0} has no loadout and will not be given one. They count as a non-combatant on every screen.
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_ActionKeepAsIs: leave as is (protected from the auto-assign, still editable).
LanguageData.CER_SquadSetup_LoadoutRemovedTip: You set this colonist to "take the loadout away". On Apply, {0} loses their assigned loadout and stands there with none - the gear itself stays in the colony. Click the icon on the far left to undo.
